'''bmackin13 Corellian Uprising''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bmackin13]]
* '''Published:''' 7 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Podrace Prep|Tat-L-podraceprep.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Local Uprising
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 LU bmackin13 LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Bionic Hand (V), Bright Hope (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This deck has been disbanded because i dont like it any more.  I will post my new deck as soon as it is made.

== Defensive Shields ==

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the deck.

* 1x {{CardLink|Aim High (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-aimhigh.gif|label=Aim High}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Affect Mind (V) (Virtual Set 2)|VS2O-01-Affect_Mind.png|label=Affect Mind (V)}}

Under An Unusual Amount Of Fear: 'Aim High - Def. Shield', 'Affect Mind (v)', and 'so its 8 other crap cards' (not named).

== Notes ==

* Description says the deck has been disbanded; the list is complete and dested as posted.
* Shields: Aim High (Reflections III shield) and Affect Mind (V) (VS2) under AUAOF; the other 8 are unnamed non-shield cards.
* Original-era (V): Affect Mind (V) (VS2); Bionic Hand (V), Bright Hope (V) (VS6).
* Posted 'Corellia Operative' (exact); 'Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (Reflections 3)' dested Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (shared title).

== Strategy ==

I try to get three operative's with three ability 3 people ASAP.  I use that to flip my objective.  With Liberation up, I draw two battle destinies at each site.  I use the really strong people like Quiggy, Luke, and Obi to go out and hopefully beat the other players people or try to get them off my planet if they use Leave Them To Me.  My spacefleet should be sufficiant to repel a non-spacefleet deck and control Corellia.  With Corellia occupied/controlled, Taking Them With Us gives my operatives a nice boost.  Also, Menace Fades and/or I Did It should take effect.  With Menace Fades, their force drain bonuses are cancelled plus they are -1 from Liberation.
